  <section class="home-content" id="take-home-exercise">
    <div class="home-main">
      <h2>Take-home Exercise 1</h2>
      <p>The current assignment investigates the spatial and spatio-temporal pattern of 2022 road accidents across the Bangkok Greater Metropolitan Area, moving from data preparation through first-order intensity to second-order interaction testing.</p>

      <div class="exercise-grid">
        <article class="exercise-card exercise-card-wide">
          <p class="card-label">Take-home Exercise 1 · 2022 BGMA Road Accidents</p>
          <h3>Spatial and Spatio-temporal Patterns of Road Accidents</h3>
          <p>Data-quality screening, monthly and space-time KDE, bandwidth sensitivity, G/F/K/L functions with CSR envelopes, inhomogeneous K, hexagon Moran's I, and a fatal/non-fatal cross-K robustness check — read against the road-network constraint on the CSR null model.</p>
          <div class="method-chips">
            <span>KDE &amp; STKDE</span>
            <span>Clark-Evans</span>
            <span>G / F / K / L</span>
            <span>Inhomogeneous K</span>
            <span>Moran's I</span>
            <span>Cross-K</span>
          </div>
          <a href="Take-home_Ex/assignment1.html">Open Technical Report</a>

  <section class="home-content" id="coursework-overview">
    <div class="home-main">
      <h2>Coursework Overview</h2>
      <p>This portfolio brings together nine hands-on chapters. The workflow moves from spatial data preparation and thematic mapping to point density, point interaction, space-time analysis, spatial weights, autocorrelation, and spatially constrained clustering.</p>
      <p>Each chapter keeps the R workflow visible, uses local data, and places short observations beside the rendered maps and statistical outputs.</p>

      <div class="exercise-grid">
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 1 · 26 Aug</p>
          <h3>Geospatial Data Science</h3>
          <p>Spatial layers, CRS transformation, point conversion, and basic geoprocessing.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex01/chap01.html">Open Chapter 1</a>
        </article>
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 1 · 28 Aug</p>
          <h3>Thematic Mapping</h3>
          <p>Population joins, choropleth classifications, facets, and dependency-ratio outliers.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex01/chap02.html">Open Chapter 2</a>
        </article>
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 2 · 30 Aug</p>
          <h3>Point Density</h3>
          <p>Point-pattern preparation, Clark-Evans tests, KDE bandwidths, and density maps.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02/chap04.html">Open Chapter 4</a>
        </article>
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 2 · 2 Sep</p>
          <h3>Point Interaction</h3>
          <p>G-, F-, K-, and L-functions with CSR simulation envelopes for two planning areas.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02/chap05.html">Open Chapter 5</a>
        </article>
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 3 · 5 Sep</p>
          <h3>Space-Time Fires</h3>
          <p>MODIS fire detections, monthly density patterns, and space-time clustering diagnostics.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex03/chap06.html">Open Chapter 6</a>
        </article>
        <article class="exercise-card">
          <p class="card-label">Hands-on Exercise 4</p>
          <h3>Spatial Weights and Applications</h3>
          <p>Queen and Rook neighbours, distance-based links, IDW, spatial lag, and window summaries.</p>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex04/chap08.html">Open Chapter 8</a>
        </article>

          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex05/chap10.html">Open Chapter 10</a>

          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex06/hands-on-exercise6.html">Open Hands-on Exercise 6</a>
